verdict.rationale: mise documents its own lockfile, with a dedicated mise-lock docs page and a `mise install --locked` workflow, plus a `mise lock` command that can emit JSON. The evidence never describes the lockfile's on-disk format, so it does not show that the file is text-based, human-readable or easy to diff. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the lockfile's text format and schema, evidence that the lockfile diffs cleanly in version control, hands-on or independent corroboration of agents reading it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at a documented, text-based lockfile format it can read and diff

citations.quote: For reproducible installs, commit a [lockfile](/dev-tools/mise-lock.html) and run `mise install --locked`.
Commit a lockfile and install with `mise install --locked`. Every job then installs the same versions
